revision_note: The reliability measure was revised after the three campaigns, for the unreadable file only: its reason stopped quoting the file at dcdd890, the file stops every change since bda51c7, since 2908ec6 until a new session is started, and since 0b6539d until Pi is reloaded or a new session is started, with a file that is not a regular file refused without its path; since 5e56368 the refusal also holds across the second session_start that Pi's RPC mode emits on the same extension. The three thresholds and the campaign measures are unchanged.

threshold_source.note: No specs/tech-architecture/e25-TEST_PLAN_LATEST.md exists; the thresholds are the three the story spec states.

environment.model: anthropic/qwen3.8-27b-oq8e — a provider named anthropic served by the local endpoint, through an isolated PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR

performance.threshold: First /495 start with no configuration file and a provider other than omlx: 0 refusals
performance.measured: Campaign e25s01-sans-config (chg_muea2bmb84f3cb90ca), no config.json in the data directory: 3 interventions started, each journalling provider_id anthropic; 0 blocks; G0..G5 PASS; accepted in 4 min 20 s. The same kept dossiers show 0 blocks under a leftover list naming only omlx (e25s01-egress-herite) and under a malformed one (e25s01-egress-malforme).
performance.note: The story removes a check before each intervention and adds none, so no latency is added on the path it touches.

reliability.threshold: Session opened without policy.egress: 0 diagnostics about the model. Session opened with policy.egress: 1 diagnostic, without the key's content
reliability.measured: e25s01-sans-config: 0 lines prefixed 495: on either stream. e25s01-egress-herite (list naming omlx) and e25s01-egress-malforme (a bare string): exactly 1 diagnostic each, 'config.json: policy.egress is no longer read; the model selected in Pi is used', and the word omlx appears nowhere in either session's output. An unreadable file is no model diagnostic: since bda51c7 it stops every change, by the owner's decision, and a cold start of the built extension answers /495 start with 'config.json cannot be read: it is not valid JSON; no change runs until it is fixed or removed', quoting neither the file's text nor its path, and creates no ledger (e25s01-illisible-refuse). Before that decision it was announced as ignored, 'Unexpected end of JSON input', then 'it is not valid JSON' after dcdd890 stopped quoting the parser's message.
reliability.note: A model with no provider still refuses at the capability check; that path is held by test/v2/model-admitted.test.ts and was not exercised for real, since Pi does not produce such a selection from /model.

operability.threshold: The diagnostic reaches every qualified Pi entry, in English like the other configuration diagnostics
operability.measured: In print mode the diagnostic is the first line of the session's output, before the status. It is a constant string, so the same text reaches the TUI and the structured entries through the one path in session.ts that announces every runtime diagnostic. test/v3/pi-entries.test.ts asserts it in the print and JSON entries.
operability.note: e25s01-egress-malforme also set language en, and its status came back in English: a setting next to the ignored key applied.
